description:
State on the git-requirement pages that git-backed operations need the git executable as well as a repository, and that the server image ships it.

## Background

- `docs/concepts/guarantees.md:233` lists what requires git, which with libgit2 linked in meant a repository only: document history, diffs and reads at a commit worked without an executable.
- `INSTALL.md:135` lists Git as optional for leases and worktree coordination.
- `docs/how-to/deployment.md` describes the server image without listing its tools.
- Without an executable, core commands behave as outside git, and claim commands fail with `REQUIRES_GIT`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `guarantees.md` states that leases, document history and diff, reads at a commit and snapshot export from a commit need the git executable on `PATH` as well as a repository, and that with no executable core commands behave as outside git.
- [hard] REQ-02: `INSTALL.md`'s optional Git entry names the operations that need the git executable.
- [hard] REQ-03: `deployment.md` states that the image includes git for document history, diffs and reads at a commit.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Git requirement pages name the git executable
